description: Systematically locate, analyze, and fix bugs. Produce a root-cause analysis before proposing any fix.
rules: Reproduce the bug before fixing it
Identify root cause — not just symptoms
Check for similar bugs in related code
Create a backup before any fix
Apply minimal change to fix the bug
Add a test case after fixing when possible
Document the fix with a clear comment explaining WHY
Verify fix does not introduce regressions
safetyNotes: Always create backup before editing files
Require permission before modifying existing files
Never delete files as a debugging step
Prefer adding safety checks over removing code
